Body.Content: Monitoring the health and performance of your Azure Container Service (AKS) cluster is important to ensure that your applications are up and running as expected. If you run applications on other Azure infrastructure, such as Virtual Machines, you have come to rely to Azure monitor to provide near real-time, granular monitoring data. We are happy to announce that you can now rely on Azure Monitor to also track the health and performance of your AKS cluster. You can view the performance at different levels of your Kubernetes cluster and can access all your container logs from a centralized location. To learn more, read the public preview announcement blog post.
